name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: Horizontally paginated content scroller. Renders a slide track with snap-points; auto-advance is OFF by default (auto-advance is a WCAG 2.2.2 hazard unless explicitly opt-in with controls). Includes prev/next IconButtons, dot indicators, and optional progress. Distinct from Tabs (sibling views) and ProductGallery (image-zoom flavor).
